x: In the six miles race we had Charlie Smart as our only representative, but Charlie put up a fine display and gained as many cheers from the crowd as did the winner, F.

For the cross-country enthusiast perhaps Frank Aaron’s run in the 10,000 metres was the most interesting. Running in his uusual dogged style he returned a time equivalent to 29.25 for six miles, which is some running!

The junior race saw a new Frank Aaron in the northern youngster Alan Cocking. To establish a lead of almost 200 yds by two miles and then coast home from a good class field was a meritorious performance.

The first major event of the year was the Inter-Counties Championship held at Leicester and it produced a clear win for Dr. Frank Aaron the Yorkshire Champion who pulled clear of the young prodigy Geoff Saunders who only four years previously had won the first National Youths' Championship.
